summary: Docker Desktop 4.86.0 (2026-08-10) is current on docs.docker.com. scripts/update_docker_desktop.ps1 is not in this repo, so the pin could not be compared. 4.86.0 and nearby notes are relevant to this Windows always-on stack (unless-stopped/stop timeouts, WSL, VirtioFS, proxy, bind-mount watchers, CVE-2026-17106).
relevant_notes: 4.86.0: Fixed container stop timeouts and unless-stopped restart policies not being honored during engine shutdown — always-on *arr Compose and endurance-coach postgres/api/mcp.
4.86.0: AF_UNIX sockets shared over VirtioFS now work host↔guest.
4.86.0: Enabling Docker Offload failed when the proxy was set by the OS instead of environment variables.
4.86.0 ships Docker Engine v29.7.2 and addresses CVE-2026-17106 (CopyEscape): docker cp copy-out destination escape from a malicious container onto the host.
4.86.0 Windows: installer could report success without writing settings/enterprise policy files; bundled 7-Zip updated to 26.02 to avoid antivirus quarantine during upgrade.
4.85.0: Linux VM kernel panic when a container inotify/fanotify watcher saw host-side bind-mount changes — endurance-coach api uses uvicorn --reload with ./src bind-mounted.
4.83.0 Windows: WSL 2.6.x+ 0-byte proxy binary (Permission denied / Exec format error); Resource Saver stopped the VM and broke Docker CLI in integrated WSL distros.
4.82.0/4.81.0: containers forced to a 1s stop timeout; Windows Hyper-V could force-off the VM without a graceful guest shutdown; WSL Resource Saver / eBPF probe start failures.
recommended_actions: Leave compose files, recovery scripts, and the Docker Desktop pin unchanged until you review this in Cursor after Watchboard turns yellow.
On the Windows host, check Docker Desktop → About and compare the installed version to 4.86.0.
If scripts/update_docker_desktop.ps1 exists only on the machine, compare its Version default to 4.86.0; it is not present in this git checkout.

If installed/pinned is older than 4.86.0, schedule a maintenance window: quit Docker Desktop, install 4.86.0 from the official notes, then confirm *arr and endurance-coach containers return with restart policies intact.
After upgrade, verify WSL integration, VirtioFS/file shares, and any system proxy; watch for antivirus quarantining 7-Zip during the Windows installer.
CVE-2026-17106 is a reason to upgrade if docker cp is used against untrusted containers; no stack config change is required for the fix.
